observations: White all-in-one copier with a glass scanning bed and a top lid.
Control panel features a numeric keypad, function buttons, and a small display.
The machine has a paper output tray at the bottom.
The top lid is shown open in photos 0, 1, and 3.
The brand 'SHARP' and model 'AR-M201' are clearly printed on the control panel in photos 1 and 2.
The machine shows visible dust and some surface wear.

claims.evidence: photo 0, 1, 2, 3 show a copier with a scanner and control panel
photos show dust and wear on the exterior
No photos show the machine powered on or producing a copy

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have a faulty display.
risks.proof: A video of the machine booting up and the LCD screen displaying text.

risks.risk: The internal toner cartridge may be empty or the drum may be near the end of its life.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner and drum status screen or a photo of the toner cartridge.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new toner cartridge

risks.risk: The automatic document feeder (ADF) may be jammed or unable to feed paper.
risks.proof: A video showing the ADF feeding a stack of paper.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and the LCD screen working.
Photo of the toner and drum status screen.
Video of the ADF feeding paper.
Photo of the rear of the machine showing the power cable and any ports.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-functional unit.
